card_name: HDFC Bank Teacher's Platinum Credit Card
reward_structure:
- For every Rs.150 spent on various purchases on your card get 2 reward points.
- Shopping during weekends (Saturday and Sunday) get 3X reward points. For every Rs. 150 spent on your card you will receive 6 reward points. 
- Since this card is specially curated for the teachers on the 5th September of every year, get 500 reward points as a teacher's day gift from HDFC Bank.
key_highlights:
- For every Rs.150 spent, earn 2 reward points.
- During weekends, get accelerated reward points of 6X during weekends.
- On Teacher's Day, get 500 reward points as a gift from the bank.
- Cardholders can save up to Rs. 500 from fuel purchases if your monthly expenses are above Rs.5,500.
- Interest free period of up to 90 days.

benefits_features.Fuel benefits:
- On all your fuel spends, the fuel surcharge of 2.5% will be absorbed by HDFC for convenience with added service tax.
- Fuel surcharge will be capped at Rs.250 per billing cycle.

how_tos.How to redeem reward points on the HDFC:
You can redeem your reward points earned on your credit card through offline and online methods.
If you wish to redeem your points offline you have to download the reward redemption form from the website and fill it with all the details required. Once you have, the form needs to be posted to the following address:
HDFC Bank Credit Division,
P.O.Box No.8654,
Thyagaraya P.O.,
Chennai - 600041.
However, if you wish to redeem your reward points, you can do so by following the steps mentioned below:
• Log in to your HDFC credit card/net banking account.
• Click on the tab of "Reward Points".
• If you have not registered your card, you must do so by adding the card number and PIN.
• Once your card has been registered, select the redeem reward points and click on continue.
• HDFC net banking website will then redirect you to the reward redemption page of the bank.
• Select the category of the items and choose points range by which to browse the catalogue of products.
• You can then select the items which you wish to add them to the cart/to purchase.
• After you have been through the products, click on the option to proceed to your shopping cart.
• Once everything checks out, you should read the terms and condition and then click the box.
• Once done, click on redeem and take the redemption order number for future references.
how_tos.How to apply for the HDFC Teacher's Plat:
You can apply for the credit card through online or offline methods. If you do not have access to the internet, you can visit the branch of HDFC Bank. Fill out the application form and submit all required documents to apply for the card.
Through online methods, you can either directly apply from the HDFC Bank website or through BankBazaar. To apply for the card through BankBazaar here are the steps you will need to follow:
• Click on the check eligibility tab on the web page of HDFC Teacher’s Platinum credit card on BankBazaar.
• Add the information which is required to fill up the online form.
• You will also need to upload all the documents required to apply for the card.
• Once done, click submit and a tracking ID will be given to you. You can use that ID to track the application status of your card.

reward_point_benefits: Earn 2 reward points for every Rs.150 spent within your card. During weekends, get 6X reward points with each transaction. On the 5th September, every year you will get 500 reward points as a special gift. Your reward points will be valid for 2 years from the date of accumulation.

fees_and_charges.Minimum repayment amount: 5% or a minimum amount of Rs.200
fees_and_charges.Cash advance charges: 2.5% of the cash advance amount withdrawn or Rs.500, The higher amount among these will be taken.
fees_and_charges.Payment return charges:
2% of the payment amount returned subjected to a minimum of Rs.100
• Less than equal to Rs.1000: Nil
• Rs.1001 to Rs.5000: Rs.100
• Rs.5001 to Rs.10000: Rs.200
• Rs.10001 to Rs.25000: Rs.400
• Rs.25001 to Rs.50000: Rs.700
• More than Rs.50000: Rs.1100
fees_and_charges.Charges once limit over account: 2.5% of the over limit amount subjected to a minimum of Rs.500
fees_and_charges.Fuel transaction surcharge: Capped at Rs.250 per statement cycle
fees_and_charges.Balance transfer processing charges: 1% of the balance transfer amount or Rs.250. The higher amount will be taken.
fees_and_charges.Card replacement charges: Rs.272. The amount will not be reversed by the bank
fees_and_charges.Outstation cheque processing charges:
If cheque value is up to Rs.5,000: Rs.25
If cheque value is more than Rs.5,000: Rs.50

faqs.How many days will it take for the cash: The sum authorized by you credited to your HDFC bank account in few days, though it is not applicable during weekends and bank holidays.
faqs.What can I do if I have been accidentall: Never hesitate to contact HDFC customer care to make sure it is entered two times and double check before approving the transaction. Moreover, if you faced a similar situation that payment is wrongly charged, two times, you immediately contact HDFC customer care.
faqs.If the bank doesn't pay for my dues, for: HDFC is constantly striving to add notes to guide their transaction service and making things easier for their clientele. But, if a certain issue is unfixed, you can write to them using MET.
faqs.Can HDFC Teacher Platinum Card owners be: Yes, it can. HDFC credit cards regularly update/ tweak their offers. But, they will fit the customers only using an existing purchase benefit and will instantly replace with another popular option.
faqs.I lost my wallet along with my credit ca: Please notify the HDFC customer care right away. They will basically check if you think that the same card is recovered. Otherwise, you will be issued a new card with a different customer service fee.
